seo.title: About Organix — Bryan Zooler & Stéphane Pfeuti | OrganixEvents
seo.description: The people behind Organix: Bryan Zooler and Stéphane Pfeuti, a snowcat brought to North Macedonia, local partners and a growing family of sport and adventure experiences.

story.title: Around fifteen years in the making.
paragraphs: Organix has existed in different forms for around fifteen years, with Stéphane at its centre. Long before the snowcat, he was already organising trips in North Macedonia.
Bryan and Stéphane met through bootfitting: during Bryan's ski racing career, Stéphane worked on his ski boots and custom footbeds.

Bryan later joined the project. Together they created OrganixEvents Sàrl, bought a snowcat and brought it to North Macedonia. With two local partners they developed Wild Tracks, the local operation — and then kept going, into new sport and adventure experiences.
In January 2026, Bryan and Stéphane also took over Art Feet, and they are developing Artfit Lab in Etoy — the same attention to feet, boots and footbeds that brought them together.

people.intro: Bryan spent more than ten years in international ski cross, as a member of the Swiss ski cross team. Racing took him to mountains all over the world — and taught him what makes a day in the mountains work.
people.text: Since then, he has turned that experience into sport, mountain and adventure projects, and into his own businesses. At Organix, he is the one on the mountain with you.
facts: Former member of the Swiss ski cross team
Entrepreneur — sport, mountain and adventure projects

people.intro: Stéphane has been the pillar of Organix for around fifteen years — and for just as long, he has been travelling to, working in and building relationships in North Macedonia.
people.text: He knows the places, the people and how to make things run on the ground. His background in bootfitting and footbeds is how he and Bryan first met.
facts: Around 15 years at the heart of Organix

local.title: Local knowledge matters.
local.text: We don't replace local professionals — we work with them. Local guides, operators and partners know their mountains best. Organix brings the structure, the experience, the network and the organisation around them.
